# settle a question about a bigger list. Each stays until the user saves it. Remove a list once discussed.

column4: line (from sample 1: Trent asks how hard a mission is; the NPC answers easy/medium/hard)
column5: Base/bar mission talk (game scenes GCS_*_F01 to F10). The NPC offers a job ("Candidly, I do need someone for a mission.") -> Trent: "All right. I'm listening." -> the job is shown -> TRENT ASKS HOW HARD IT IS with one of his variants: "Is it dangerous?" / "Is it a tough one?" / "Rough odds?" / "Hazardous?" / "Dangerous?" / "Unpleasant?" (this line) / "Risky?" / "Is it tough?" -> the NPC answers by the job's difficulty: easy "Don't sweat it, pal. A walk in the park.", medium "Could be kind of bumpy, but you'll pull through.", hard "Yeah, you'll be scrappin' some." -> Trent accepts ("Okay. Give me the details.") or declines ("No, thanks. I'm not really interested."). So this one word is Trent's question about the job's danger.
